summary.claim: Historical pressure-performance indicator; persistence not demonstrated. Its ability to predict IPL 2027 is not established (D15).
exec_summary: We rated 47 batters, 71 bowlers and 8 all-rounders on how they performed when a ball could swing the match (IPL 2023–26).
RR's measured gaps: middle-overs batting, death-overs batting under pressure; RR's bowling under pressure is above league in every phase.
Must-Back if available: Ashutosh Sharma, Patrick Cummins. Plan A in an assumed Rs 15 cr purse: Patrick Cummins, Abdul Samad, Ashutosh Sharma, Sameer Rizvi.
Honest test (top 10 still above average next season): batters 42.9% v naive 46.7% v random pick 50.8%; bowlers 72.8% v 75.0% v 59.5%. Verdict: persistence not demonstrated.
So read it as proof of past pressure performance, not a promise; prices, ages and availability are unverified assumptions to recheck before 16 Dec.

squad_still_lacks: RR's gaps are directional, not proven (every phase gap is within noise except powerplay batting, which is above league). Plan A adds pressure-proven options for middle-overs batting, death-overs batting, but at walk-away prices it costs Rs 21 cr against an assumed Rs 15 cr purse, and Must-Back players' availability is unverified.
